projects.title: Cultural Encounters — Australia × Vietnam
projects.lead: A proposed inaugural gathering weaving contemporary visual arts, live performance and cultural dialogue into one shared experience.
projects.description: VCACE is developing its first cultural showcase in Brisbane, bringing together Australia- and Vietnam-connected practitioners for a curated exhibition, an artist-led conversation and an intimate performance. The project aims to create new connections and the foundations for future bilateral collaboration.
projects.note: Proposed project. Artists, venue, dates, funding and partners are still to be confirmed.

projects.title: Culture Through the Five Senses
projects.lead: A pilot exploring Australian and Vietnamese culture through taste, sound, touch, scent and sight.

projects.title: Music & Creative Collaboration
projects.lead: Bringing musicians and creative practitioners from both countries together to make new work.

projects.title: Living Heritage Lab
projects.lead: Working with heritage practitioners on living traditions, with a possible cultural visit component.
